album.forget_confirm: Remove “{name}” from the local list? The Discord thread stays untouched.
album.create_label: Album name (becomes the forum post title):
queue.empty:
Queue is empty.
Capture the screen/a window/a region, or drop finished files here (PNG/JPG/WebP/GIF).
queue.capture_hint: Full screen · active window · region (Ctrl+Shift+S / Ctrl+Shift+R)
send.duplicate_caption: Repeat the caption in every message
send.album_shots: Shots already sent to this album: {n}
send.empty_name: Fill in the section name — it goes into the caption and the filename (“Name | N.png”)
send.no_album: Pick or create an album on the left first
send.no_shots: Check at least one screenshot in the queue
result.aborted: Cancelled · part of the batch may have gone out — check the thread
error.webhook_dead: Webhook is gone or the channel is unreachable — check the profile and recreate the webhook
error.too_large: File is too large (≈20 MiB) — Discord refused the upload
error.forum: A forum needs a thread — pick an album or create one (＋ New)
error.rate_limited: Discord rate-limited the requests — wait and retry
error.transient: Discord is unavailable or a network error occurred — try again
error.validation: Discord rejected the message — check the caption and album selection
error.unknown: Unknown error — see the send history
settings.title: Settings
settings.profile_remove_confirm: Delete profile “{name}”? Its albums will be removed from the local list too (history and the Discord threads are kept).
settings.err_missing: Profile not found — refresh the list
settings.ask_hint: “Ask” uses the mode chosen in the main window — the choice is remembered after each send.
settings.clear_fields: Clear the caption fields after sending
settings.language_restart: Language saved. Restart the app to apply.
settings.cache_keep: Keep sent screenshots locally (needed for BB-code export)
settings.cache_clear_confirm: Delete all files from the local screenshot cache? The send history is kept.
settings.backup_warning: The backup file contains webhook URLs — treat it as a secret (don't paste into chats or commit to git).
settings.import_confirm: Import replaces current settings, profiles, albums and history with the file's contents. The current files will be backed up first. Continue?
settings.import_done:
Import complete. Backup of the previous data:
{path}
settings.connect_timeout: Discord did not respond in time (3 minutes).
settings.connect_prefill: Webhook received ✓  Set a name and press “Add”.
bb.title: BB code: {album}
bb.source_note: Discord links expire within a day but work immediately. catbox.moe gives permanent direct links: files are uploaded from the local cache once (idempotent — re-exports never re-upload).
bb.empty: No successful sends in this album's history — send a batch first.
bb.missing_catbox: Not found in cache or without a link: {missing}. Those are skipped; note the local cache must stay enabled.
settings.subtitle: Webhooks, sending and the app
settings.oauth_clear_confirm: Delete the saved credentials (oauth.client.json) from disk?
settings.oauth_configured: Credentials saved — the “Connect Discord” button is ready to use.
settings.oauth_not_configured: No credentials yet. Fill in the fields below — the app will create oauth.client.json itself.
settings.connect_need_setup: Save Client ID and Client Secret above first — the app will create oauth.client.json by itself.
settings.about_text: Screensaver → Discord {version}. Portable utility: lives next to main.py, installs nothing.
common.need_profile: Add a webhook profile first (Settings → Profiles). Open settings?
settings.oauth_builtin_warn: The Client ID field holds the project's built-in ID. It only works with the secret of that same app (owner-only). If you are not the author: create your own app at discord.com/developers/applications and enter ITS Client ID and Client Secret. The same app must have this Redirect URI registered (OAuth2 → Redirects): {uri}
settings.oauth_pair_hint: Client ID and Client Secret must come from the same app at discord.com/developers/applications, and that exact app must have this Redirect URI registered (OAuth2 → Redirects): {uri} (exactly, including http, localhost, port and path).
